pure-announcement.rationale: It is independent practitioner analysis of a specification's migration state, not a vendor launch or release note.

duplicate.rationale: None of the supplied nearest concepts (SIEM visibility gap, protocol lifecycle policy, context layer) covers the OTel GenAI semantic conventions or their multi-generation attribute problem.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Every claim is anchored to dated releases, linked repositories and the author's own exported traces, all independently checkable.

durability.rationale: The bulk is an explicitly dated snapshot — a rename timeline across six releases and a per-framework emission matrix as of 2026-07-17 — that the next convention release will obsolete, with the own-your-internal-representation advice the durable remainder.

actionability.rationale: It gives directly usable practices: coalesce both attribute generations with precedence and never sum them, pin framework/SDK/exporter versions, publish a dated tested-with table, and keep custom attributes out of the reserved gen_ai.* namespace.

atomicity.rationale: Timeline, framework survey and guidance all serve one stateable thesis: 'OpenTelemetry-compatible' is not yet a sufficient schema contract for GenAI telemetry, so normalize, pin and date what you run.
